title: A New Home on Maple Street

sents.t: My name is Sam.
I am twenty-five years old.
Today is my first day in America!
My new home is in Oakville.
It is a small town with big green trees.
I have a small apartment on Maple Street.
It has one bedroom, a little kitchen, and a big window.
From my window, I can see a park and a red coffee shop.
In the morning, I open the door.
My neighbor is outside.
She has a brown dog.
“Hi! I’m Rosa,” she says.
“And this is Max.”
“Hi, Rosa. I’m Sam. Nice to meet you!”
“Nice to meet you too, Sam. Welcome to Oakville!”
Max is very friendly.
He likes me!
Rosa and I walk to the coffee shop.
I order a coffee and a muffin.
The coffee is hot, and the muffin is sweet.
The man at the counter smiles.
“Have a nice day!” he says.
I am happy.
I don’t know many people here, but I have a new friend.
My new life starts today.
